post.caption:
Tiktaalik lived around 375 million years ago and had fins with wrist bones, a neck, lungs and gills. It was found by predicting exactly which rock age and shoreline to dig in, then going there. Every land vertebrate descends from that move, and your arm bones are that fin rearranged.
